desc:
DELICIOUS TASTE: Each box of crunchy lattice squares brings an irresistible strawberry vanilla taste your whole family can enjoy; Keep a box in your pantry for a morning food that's ready to eat any time

WHOLE GRAIN: Helps get your day off to a good start with 13g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

GLUTEN FREE CEREAL: Pour some in a bowl with milk for a great-tasting, gluten free part of an easy breakfast; Pack some in a lunch box or backpack for snacks on the go; Add to homemade cereal bars as snacks for kids

VITAMINS AND MINERALS: Beyond the delicious taste, every serving is a good source of 12 vitamins and minerals, and made without high fructose corn syrup, or artificial flavors or colors from artificial sources

CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy Strawberry Vanilla Chex Cereal, Gluten Free Breakfast Cereal, Family Size, 19.8 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Key Features:

Flavor Combo: A unique blend of sweet strawberry and creamy vanilla on crispy rice Chex pieces.

Whole Grain: Contains 13 grams of whole grains per serving.

Gluten-Free: Ideal for individuals with gluten intolerance or celiac disease.

No Artificial Ingredients: Made without artificial colors, flavors, or high-fructose corn syrup.

Fortified Nutrition: Includes essential vitamins and minerals like iron, calcium, and vitamin D.

Benefits:

Kid-Friendly Taste: Sweet but not overpowering—perfect for picky eaters.

Healthy Breakfast Option: A nutritious way to start the day with added vitamins and whole grains.

Great for Snacks: Works well as a dry snack, in snack mixes, or even dessert toppings.

Convenient: Quick, easy breakfast or snack choice with no prep needed.
ingredients: Whole Grain Rice, Rice, Sugar, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, Molasses, Color (vegetable juice), Natural Flavor, Rosemary Extract. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Tricalcium Phosphate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
